ParameterPoolEntry.Name: DoorMoveDelay
ParameterPoolEntry.Description: Defines the delay between the start of several doors

ParameterPoolEntry.Name: DoorPollingDelay
ParameterPoolEntry.Description: Defines the delay the polling of the SecurityButtton/MotorState before/during a move

ParameterPoolEntry.Name: WaitForButtonPressedTime
ParameterPoolEntry.Description: Defines the max wait time the button has to be pressed (in ms)

ParameterPoolEntry.Name: DoorLockTimeout
ParameterPoolEntry.Description: Defines the timeout when the door is closed/locked until the state in the DataPool is updated (in ms)
